From 0091eda01412805e0d2c8025638ac0992102a7fc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Daniel Gabay <daniel.gabay@intel.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2024 20:03:03 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: iwlwifi: fix iwl_mvm_get_valid_rx_ant()

Fix incorrect use of _tx_ valid ant data in the function.

Fixes: 4ea1ed1d14d8 ("wifi: iwlwifi: mvm: support set_antenna()")
Signed-off-by: Daniel Gabay <daniel.gabay@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Emmanuel Grumbach <emmanuel.grumbach@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Miri Korenblit <miriam.rachel.korenblit@intel.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20240618200104.b7c6a320c7dc.I3092eb5275056f2162b9694e583c310c38568b2a@changeid
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/mvm/mvm.h b/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/mvm/mvm.h
index 54c3553db219..4ced1e51c908 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/mvm/mvm.h
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/mvm/mvm.h
@@ -1875,10 +1875,10 @@ static inline u8 iwl_mvm_get_valid_tx_ant(struct iwl_mvm *mvm)
 
 static inline u8 iwl_mvm_get_valid_rx_ant(struct iwl_mvm *mvm)
 {
-	u8 rx_ant = mvm->fw->valid_tx_ant;
+	u8 rx_ant = mvm->fw->valid_rx_ant;
 
 	if (mvm->nvm_data && mvm->nvm_data->valid_rx_ant)
-		rx_ant &= mvm->nvm_data->valid_tx_ant;
+		rx_ant &= mvm->nvm_data->valid_rx_ant;
 
 	if (mvm->set_rx_ant)
 		rx_ant &= mvm->set_rx_ant;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/mvm/mvm.h`**
   - The function `iwl_mvm_get_valid_rx_ant` was modified to correct the use of antenna data:
     - Changed the assignment of `rx_ant` from `mvm->fw->valid_tx_ant` to `mvm->fw->valid_rx_ant`.
     - Updated the conditional check to use `valid_rx_ant` instead of `valid_tx_ant` when applying the bitwise AND operation with `rx_ant`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `mvm.h` file are directly related to fixing a bug in the `iwl_mvm_get_valid_rx_ant` function. The original implementation incorrectly used transmission antenna data (`valid_tx_ant`) instead of reception antenna data (`valid_rx_ant`). This change ensures that the function correctly retrieves and processes the valid reception antenna information, which is crucial for the proper functioning of the wireless driver. The patch addresses a specific issue introduced in a previous commit, thereby improving the accuracy of antenna selection in the driver.
